description: Shell commands added to the palette, with optional keys.

name.patternMessage: must be one line, not blank
name.description: The name shown in the palette, unique in the file.

output.description: What happens to the output: replace the selection, insert it after the selection, or show it in a read-only tab.

key.patternMessage: must be a key such as ctrl+alt+k, with Ctrl, Alt or a function key
key.description: A key that runs the command, such as ctrl+alt+k.

items.patternMessage: must be a key such as ctrl+alt+k, with Ctrl, Alt or a function key

keys.description: Several keys that run the command; used when key is absent.
